set.body: Topofmri task-GLM recovery at commit 2d95dde found three stored-result discrepancies on nearly absent cue columns. Independent retained-row, centered/unit-scaled QR and direct projection agree to about 1e-11 to 1e-12, while fmrireg-based stored residuals differ by 9.92e-6, 3.40e-3, and 2.33e-3. Two affected retained cue norms are about 2.19e-10. A synthetic fmrireg 0.2.0 case reproduces the mechanism: a cue supported mostly on a censored frame plus a one-hot censor spike, with a retained tail of 1e-9, yields a roughly 3.376e-3 retained fitted-value discrepancy versus the retained-row scaled-QR oracle. The synthetic case emits a rank-deficiency warning whereas the production runs completed, so exact attribution remains pending retrieval of the Trillium artifacts. Confirm against pinned fmrireg SHA 886ae4bb8212f0eab4662d279fc5dc20d9364e28 and the three real designs; test spike-augmented full-design versus dropped-censored-row equivalence, scaling and column permutation invariance, and an independent projection oracle. If confirmed, fix in fmrireg and then bump topofmri's frozen provider SHA; do not relax study thresholds or exclusions. Related topofmri issues: bd-01M2BXKTVJ60TS9ZPBSHDR1CC9 and bd-01M2BXCG37RXGJ33YPC8E6GY6M.
set.title: Investigate spike-censor OLS instability on nearly absent retained regressors
